items.q: Hyaline membranes lining alveoli in a preterm newborn with grunting and retractions indicate what?
o: Respiratory distress syndrome from surfactant deficiency
items.exp: Surfactant deficiency collapses alveoli whose injured epithelium plus fibrin forms hyaline membranes, causing hypoxaemia rescued by exogenous surfactant and supportive ventilation. Lecithin sphingomyelin maturity predicts risk.
r: Incorrect. Meconium obstructs and inflames term airways differently.
Correct. Hyaline membranes mean surfactant deficiency RDS.
Incorrect. Retained fluid lacks membranes and resolves in days.
Incorrect. Pneumonia shows neutrophilic exudates and organisms.
items.kp: Preterm plus hyaline membranes equals RDS. Give surfactant.

items.q: Pneumatosis intestinalis in a feeding intolerant preterm infant diagnoses what until proven otherwise?
items.exp: Gas within bowel wall (pneumatosis) with feed intolerance, distension and bloody stools in prematurity is necrotising enterocolitis, a surgical emergency spectrum needing fasting, antibiotics and monitoring for perforation.
r: Incorrect. Hirschsprung causes delayed meconium and obstruction without wall gas pattern.
Correct. Wall gas in preterm gut means necrotising enterocolitis.
Incorrect. Volvulus twists with bilious vomiting and whirlpool signs.
Incorrect. Allergy causes bloody stools without pneumatosis emergency.
items.kp: Preterm plus pneumatosis equals NEC until proven otherwise.

items.q: Opsoclonus myoclonus (dancing eyes) paraneoplastic syndrome in a toddler points to which tumour?
items.exp: Neuroblastoma (sympathetic neural crest) secretes catecholamines and associates with opsoclonus myoclonus ataxia, secretory diarrhoea (VIP) and MYCN driven prognosis. Urinary VMA and HVA screen it.
r: Incorrect. Wilms is renal triphasic without this syndrome.
Correct. Dancing eyes mean hunt neuroblastoma.
Incorrect. Retinoblastoma presents with leukocoria eye reflex loss.
Incorrect. Hepatoblastoma raises AFP in liver masses.
items.kp: Dancing eyes in a toddler: image the adrenals and sympathetic chain.

items.q: Aniridia with Wilms tumour and genitourinary anomalies (WAGR) results from deletion involving which gene region?
items.exp: WAGR deletes 11p13 removing WT1 (Wilms suppressor) and PAX6 (aniridia), predisposing to Wilms tumour needing renal surveillance. Denys Drash and Beckwith Wiedemann also predispose through WT1 or imprinting.
r: Incorrect. RB1 loss causes retinoblastoma and osteosarcoma risk.
Correct. WT1 deletion at 11p13 causes WAGR Wilms risk.
Incorrect. APC causes colonic polyposis syndromes.
Incorrect. RET activation causes MEN2 cancers.
items.kp: Aniridia plus childhood kidney mass risk equals WT1 deletion.

items.q: White pupillary reflex (leukocoria) in a toddler should trigger urgent exclusion of what?
items.exp: Retinoblastoma fills the eye with white tumour (flexner wintersteiner rosettes) abolishing red reflex, from biallelic RB1 loss (heritable bilateral versus sporadic unilateral). Delayed diagnosis risks optic and systemic spread.
r: Incorrect. Cataract clouds lens but retinoblastoma must outrank it urgently.
Correct. Leukocoria means exclude retinoblastoma first.
Incorrect. ROP affects preterm retinas under screening already.
Incorrect. Vascular remnants lack malignant urgency profile.
items.kp: White reflex in a toddler is retinoblastoma until ophthalmology clears it.

items.q: Stage 4S neuroblastoma in a young infant is remarkable because it may do what?
o: Spontaneously regress despite liver, skin and marrow spread
items.exp: Infant 4S (special) neuroblastoma spreads to liver, skin (blueberry muffin) and limited marrow yet often regresses spontaneously with excellent outcome, contrasting MYCN amplified aggressive disease.
r: Incorrect. Brain spread is uncommon and not defining.
Correct. 4S disease characteristically regresses.
Incorrect. Tumour types do not transform into each other here.
Incorrect. Regression still needs staged observation protocols.
items.kp: Infant metastatic neuroblastoma can melt away: stage 4S.

items.q: Potter sequence oligohydramnios facies and lung hypoplasia result from which primary defect cascade?
o: Fetal urinary failure (renal agenesis or obstruction) reducing amniotic fluid
items.exp: Amniotic fluid is fetal urine late in gestation, so bilateral renal agenesis or obstruction dehydrates the sac, moulding flat facies and lethally hypoplastic lungs (Potter sequence). One defect cascades mechanically.
r: Incorrect. Single artery is a soft marker, not this cascade.
Correct. No urine, no fluid, moulded face and small lungs.
Incorrect. Diabetes enlarges rather than dehydrates fetuses.
Incorrect. Trisomies malform without this fluid mechanism specifically.
items.kp: Sequence means one defect mechanically cascades: Potter proves it.

items.q: Omphalocele differs from gastroschisis most testably how?
o: Omphalocele is uncovered bowel right of cord
Omphalocele is midline sac covered defect with high chromosomal association; gastroschisis is uncovered lateral defect usually isolated
Gastroschisis always has sac and syndromes
items.exp: Omphalocele herniates through the cord into a membrane sac midline with frequent chromosomal and cardiac associations, while gastroschisis eviscerates uncovered bowel beside a normal cord, usually isolated and surgically urgent.
r: Incorrect. That describes gastroschisis anatomy reversed.
Correct. Sac plus syndromes equals omphalocele; bare lateral bowel equals gastroschisis.
Incorrect. Associations and coverage differ decisively.
Incorrect. Gastroschisis by definition lacks a sac.
items.kp: Sac midline thinks chromosomes; bare side bowel thinks isolated surgery.

items.q: Diaphragmatic hernia newborn respiratory distress with scaphoid abdomen and bowel sounds in chest is most often which side and defect?
items.exp: Bochdalek posterolateral defects (usually left) let bowel herniate into chest, hypoplasing lung and shifting mediastinum, causing immediate respiratory distress with sunken abdomen. Pulmonary hypertension drives management.
r: Incorrect. Morgagni anterior defects present later and milder.
Correct. Left Bochdalek is the classic neonatal emergency.
Incorrect. Central defects are rare without this classic picture.
Incorrect. Hiatal hernias cause reflux, not this neonatal collapse.
items.kp: Scaphoid belly plus chest bowel in a newborn equals Bochdalek hernia.

items.q: Back to sleep campaigns reduced SIDS by modifying which factor class?
o: Environmental sleep position and bedding risks in vulnerable infants
items.exp: Prone sleep, soft bedding, bed sharing and overheating interact with vulnerable arousal development (triple risk model), so supine positioning cut SIDS rates markedly without changing genetics.
r: Incorrect. Genes set vulnerability but campaigns changed environment.
Correct. Sleep environment modification prevented deaths.
Incorrect. Infection plays no proven campaign role.
Incorrect. Folate prevents neural tube defects, not SIDS.
items.kp: SIDS prevention is environmental: back, firm, bare crib.
